description: Source file implementing a cache for client composition requests in Android's surfaceflinger composition engine, including classes and functions for managing display and layer settings.

classes.name: ClientCompositionRequestCache::ClientCompositionRequest
classes.description: Represents a cached client composition request, including display settings and layer settings snapshots.

methods.name: ClientCompositionRequestCache::ClientCompositionRequest::equals
methods.description: Checks if the current request equals given display and layer settings.

methods.name: ClientCompositionRequestCache::exists
methods.description: Checks if a request with specific buffer ID, display, and layer settings exists in the cache.

methods.name: ClientCompositionRequestCache::add
methods.description: Adds a new request to the cache, replacing existing one if buffer ID matches, and manages cache size.

methods.name: ClientCompositionRequestCache::remove
methods.description: Removes a request from the cache based on buffer ID.
